تعجرفتما (form IIq)
# تَعَجْرَفْتُمَا (taʕajraftumā) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.raf.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تُعُجْرِفْتُمَا (tuʕujriftumā) /tu.ʕud͡ʒ.rif.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
